analysis.reasonEn: RSI rises from 53.9 to 62.2, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improves from 4.2171 to 4.4334, maintaining upward momentum. While the 5-day high of $384.04 and 20-day high of $384.04 indicate no new highs, suggesting potential sideways movement, the price remains above SMA5 ($362.38), SMA20 ($347.45), and SMA50 ($358.48), maintaining bullish alignment. Volume ratio of 1.14 supports movement reliability. Despite weekly RSI at 50.9 (neutral), daily bullish alignment and rising RSI favor a buy entry.
